name: prior_year.import
description: Prior-year CSV import (AFC-485, data-model-expansion §13). Validate + insert, idempotent. Triggered by a CSV upload; the Nuxt route POST /api/imports/:domain is the executor (ADR-0010 decision 4: no new service — the Flow documents the job, the route runs it).

input.filename: optional original name for the ledger

steps.name: Validate rows
steps.on: header must match the domain template exactly; per-row rules per prior-year-import.ts
steps.failure: 400 with per-row error report; nothing is written (header errors) or only valid rows proceed (row errors, reported explicitly as partial)

steps.name: Permission scope
steps.on: fail-closed: unknown branch_code is a row error; out-of-scope branch is a row error, never a silent skip
steps.failure: 403 for unscoped sessions; row-level errors otherwise

steps.name: Idempotent insert
steps.action: read-then-write on the domain natural key

keys.attendance: (branch, session_date, service_type) session + (session, category, sex) counts
keys.people: identity hash (email/phone exact match; creates only, never overwrites PII)
keys.finance: (branch, month); weca_returns found-or-created as formula_pending for weca.calculate

steps.outcome: imported | updated | skipped per row; re-import yields zero new rows (suite 81)

steps.name: Record provenance
steps.action: insert prior_year_imports batch (source=import, data_year, counts, imported_by) + prior_year_import_items rows (natural_key, target link, status)
steps.on: ledger tables missing (pre-0014) must not fail the import: response reports ledger=pending_migration_0014
steps.failure: tolerated; the per-row report is the source of truth for the caller

steps.name: Report
steps.action: return { received, imported, updated, skipped, errors[], import_id, ledger }
steps.on: caller shows the per-row error report; partial imports are explicit and reversible by batch (reviewed migrator step, never app DELETE)

compareViews.attendance: GET /api/attendance/report?compare_prior_year=true (+ report.csv streams the same query with the prior section)
compareViews.blessings: GET /api/blessings?compare_prior_year=true (+ reports.csv streams the same query with the prior section)
compareViews.finance: GET /api/finance/summary?period=YYYY-MM&compare_prior_year=true (same month one year back + delta)
compareViews.people: GET /api/people/compare?group_by=branch|zone&data_year=YYYY (+ compare.csv streams the same grouping)

notes: Retention/consent automation reuses the ADR-0009 runtime; this Flow adds no new service, secret, or dependency.
The ledger stores no raw PII: people items carry only the SHA-256 identity hash.
Adding source columns to the domain tables is deferred to a CTO-approved follow-up (personal-data approval path).
